description: CLI Dashboard Production Ready - Transform the terminal dashboard into a polished, production-ready developer tool with embedded Claude chat, Ralph loop controls, improved task management, and real-time updates.

userStories.title: Add Chat tab to dashboard navigation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a dedicated Chat tab so I can access AI assistance from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: New 'Chat' tab added to TABS array in dashboard.tsx
renderView() returns ChatView component for 'chat' tab

userStories.title: Create ChatView component with message display
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see my chat history in the Chat tab so I can reference previous conversations.
acceptanceCriteria: src/cli/components/ChatView.tsx exists (may need updates from existing)
Displays message history from database with timestamps
User messages styled differently from assistant messages
Messages scroll with arrow keys, auto-scroll to bottom on new messages
Loading state shown while fetching history
userStories.notes: ChatView component already exists - enhance it for dashboard integration

userStories.title: Add chat input with multi-line support
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to type multi-line prompts so I can ask complex questions.
acceptanceCriteria: TextInput component at bottom of ChatView
Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter submits the prompt
Input disabled while waiting for response
userStories.notes: ChatInput component added with ink-text-input, enter/ctrl+enter submit, escape clear, character count

userStories.title: Stream Claude responses in chat
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see responses stream in real-time so I know Claude is working.
acceptanceCriteria: Responses appear token-by-token as they stream
Can scroll up to pause auto-scroll
userStories.notes: Streaming implemented with Anthropic SDK MessageStream, spinner animation, auto-scroll with pause on user scroll up

userStories.title: Add project context selector to chat
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to select which project Claude should know about.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown/selector at top of ChatView for project selection
Lists all registered projects plus 'No project' option
Project context sent with each prompt
userStories.notes: ProjectSelector component with 'p' key toggle, arrow keys for navigation, Enter to confirm, selected project shown in header and used for context

userStories.title: Add Loops tab to dashboard
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a dedicated tab to manage Ralph loops.
acceptanceCriteria: New 'Loops' tab added after Chat tab
Empty LoopsView component renders for 'loops' tab
userStories.notes: Loops tab with shortcut '0' added to dashboard, LoopsView component created

userStories.title: Create loops database table
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store Ralph loop state in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: loops table created with columns: id, project_id, branch_name, prd_path, status, max_iterations, current_iteration, started_at, completed_at, created_at
loop_iterations table: id, loop_id, iteration_number, story_id, status, output, commit_sha, started_at, completed_at
userStories.notes: loops and loop_iterations tables added to src/db/index.ts with indexes for project_id, status, loop_id

userStories.title: Create LoopsView component with loop list
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see all my Ralph loops in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Each loop shows: project name, branch, status, progress (e.g., 3/10), duration
Running loops sorted first, then by created_at DESC
Status color-coded: running=green, paused=yellow, completed=cyan, failed=red
Arrow keys navigate list, Enter opens detail view
userStories.notes: LoopRepository and LoopIterationRepository created in src/loops/, LoopsView with list and detail view

userStories.title: Add new loop creation dialog
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to start a Ralph loop from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: 'n' key opens new loop creation dialog
userStories.notes: CreateLoopDialog with Tab navigation, auto-generated branch name from PRD path

userStories.title: Implement loop start functionality
userStories.description: As a developer, I want loops to actually start when I create them.
acceptanceCriteria: startLoop() function creates loop record in database
Spawns ralph.sh subprocess with project path and prd file
Output captured and stored in loop_iterations table
userStories.notes: LoopRunner module created with start/pause/resume/stop, output monitoring with iteration tracking

userStories.title: Add loop progress display
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see real-time progress of running loops.
acceptanceCriteria: Current story title and status displayed
userStories.notes: ProgressBar component with PRD reading, spinner animation, LoopProgressDisplay for detail view

userStories.title: Add pause and resume loop controls
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to pause a loop to review changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Pause takes effect after current iteration completes
userStories.notes: 'p' pauses running loops, 'r' resumes paused loops, visual indicators added

userStories.title: Add stop loop control
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to stop a loop if something goes wrong.
userStories.notes: 's' key opens StopConfirmationDialog, Enter confirms with reason, LoopRunner.stop() kills process and records reason

userStories.title: Add loop iteration history view
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see what each iteration did.
acceptanceCriteria: Enter on loop opens detail view with iteration list
Each iteration shows: story title, status, duration, commit SHA
Expand iteration to see full output
userStories.notes: Enhanced LoopDetailView with story title lookup, red highlighting for failed iterations, scrollable full output display

userStories.title: Add task search to Queue view
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to search tasks quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: '/' key opens search input in QueueView
Search filters by title, project, or type
userStories.notes: '/' opens search, filters by title/project/type, 150ms debounce, ESC clears, yellow highlight on matches

userStories.title: Add task filter controls to Queue
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to filter tasks by status and type.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter bar at top of QueueView
Status filter: All | Pending | Running | Completed | Failed
Type filter: All | Feature | Bug | Test | Docs | Refactor
userStories.notes: FilterBar component with Tab cycling, arrow keys for value change, combines with search

userStories.title: Add enhanced task detail view
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see everything about a task.
acceptanceCriteria: Enter on task opens full-screen detail view
Shows: title, description, acceptance criteria, status
userStories.notes: TaskDetailView component with full task info, parsed acceptance criteria from prdJson, execution history with expandable output

userStories.title: Add quick task creation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to create tasks quickly with smart defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: 'c' key in Queue view opens quick create
Project auto-selected if only one registered
userStories.notes: QuickCreateDialog with Tab cycling, type inference from title keywords, auto-project selection, smart defaults

userStories.title: Add worker log search
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to search worker output logs.
acceptanceCriteria: '/' key in WorkerDetailView opens log search
'n' jumps to next match, 'N' to previous

userStories.title: Add worker output level filtering
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to filter worker output by level.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter options: All | Errors | Warnings | Info
Line count by level shown in header

userStories.title: Add self-improvement status section to Health tab
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see self-improvement status in the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows: last analysis time, proposals in queue
Shows: pending approvals count, recent results

userStories.title: Add self-improvement proposal list
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see pending self-improvement proposals.
acceptanceCriteria: Proposal list shows title, type, risk score
Color coding: green (<40 risk), yellow (40-70), red (>70)

userStories.title: Add proposal approve/reject controls
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to approve or reject proposals from dashboard.

userStories.title: Add keyboard shortcut help overlay
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see all keyboard shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: '?' key opens shortcut help overlay from any screen
Shortcuts grouped by context (global, queue, workers, etc.)

userStories.title: Add notification bell to header
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see when things need attention.
acceptanceCriteria: Bell icon with count in Header component
Count includes: pending approvals, failed tasks, critical alerts

userStories.title: Create notifications database table
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to persist notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: notifications table: id, type, title, message, severity, read, created_at

userStories.title: Add notification list view
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see all my notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows recent notifications sorted by created_at DESC

userStories.title: Add loading states to all views
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see loading indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Spinner shown during initial data load in each view
Loading never blocks keyboard input for tab switching

userStories.title: Add empty states to all views
userStories.description: As a developer, I want helpful messages when there's no data.
acceptanceCriteria: QueueView: 'No tasks yet. Press c to create one.'
LoopsView: 'No loops yet. Press n to start one.'
Empty states show relevant keyboard shortcut

userStories.title: Add error handling wrapper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want clear error messages, not stack traces.

userStories.title: Add tab badges for attention items
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see counts on tabs that need attention.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue tab shows pending task count
Approvals tab shows pending approval count
Workers tab shows running worker count
Health tab shows critical alert count

userStories.title: Reorganize tabs for better workflow
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tabs ordered by importance.

userStories.title: Standardize navigation patterns
userStories.description: As a developer, I want consistent navigation everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Arrow keys always navigate lists in all views
Number keys always switch main tabs

userStories.title: Add consistent color coding
userStories.description: As a developer, I want colors to mean the same thing everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Status colors consistent: green=success/running, red=failed/error, yellow=warning/paused, cyan=completed, gray=pending
Task type colors consistent across Queue, Approvals, PRD Editor

userStories.title: Add footer context hints
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the footer to show relevant shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer shows context-specific shortcuts based on active tab
